answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the pigment seed, the ferrous timing is verifiable from the orchard record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 475 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is trivial once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 257 keys as a result burns 257 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
